calories-burned-calculator.question: What is a MET value?
calories-burned-calculator.answer: MET (Metabolic Equivalent of Task) measures the ratio of working metabolic rate relative to resting energy expenditure.

healthy-weight-calculator.title: Healthy Weight Calculator
healthy-weight-calculator.description: Find your healthy weight range and ideal target weight based on height and BMI standards.
healthy-weight-calculator.how: Enter current height and weight to compare against World Health Organization adult healthy boundaries.
healthy-weight-calculator.limits: Thresholds apply to adults aged 20 and older and do not substitute for comprehensive metabolic clinical exams.
healthy-weight-calculator.question: What BMI range is recognized as healthy weight?
healthy-weight-calculator.answer: A BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is recognized globally as the standard healthy adult weight range.

heart-rate-calculator.title: Heart Rate Calculator
heart-rate-calculator.description: Convert manual pulse counts to BPM and calculate target training heart rate zones.
heart-rate-calculator.how: Count your radial or carotid pulse over 15, 30, or 60 seconds to compute beats per minute and target aerobic zones.
heart-rate-calculator.limits: Age-predicted maximal heart rate equations carry standard deviations of 10 to 12 beats per minute.
heart-rate-calculator.question: How does resting heart rate relate to cardiovascular fitness?
heart-rate-calculator.answer: Higher aerobic conditioning generally lowers resting heart rate by increasing cardiac stroke volume.

ideal-weight-calculator.title: Ideal Weight Calculator
ideal-weight-calculator.description: Calculate your ideal body weight using Robinson, Miller, Devine, and Hamwi formulas.
ideal-weight-calculator.how: Select gender and enter height to compare benchmark calculations across four validated clinical equations.
ideal-weight-calculator.limits: Formulas produce population statistical approximations and do not consider individual frame breadth or athletic muscularity.
ideal-weight-calculator.question: Why do the four formulas yield slightly different results?
ideal-weight-calculator.answer: Each formula was derived from independent clinical research cohorts with varying historical base heights and baselines.

lean-body-mass-calculator.title: Lean Body Mass Calculator
lean-body-mass-calculator.description: Calculate your lean body mass and fat mass based on body weight and fat percentage.
lean-body-mass-calculator.how: Enter total body weight and body fat percentage to separate total body weight into adipose tissue and metabolically active lean mass.
lean-body-mass-calculator.limits: Body composition calculations are only as accurate as the underlying body fat percentage measurement.
lean-body-mass-calculator.question: Why is tracking lean body mass important during weight loss?
lean-body-mass-calculator.answer: Monitoring lean mass ensures that caloric deficits cause adipose reduction rather than muscular atrophy.

running-calories-calculator.title: Running Calories Calculator
running-calories-calculator.description: Estimate calories burned while running based on speed, distance, and body weight.
running-calories-calculator.how: Select your pace bracket, enter distance in kilometers, and input your body weight to calculate net and gross calorie expenditure.
running-calories-calculator.limits: Wind resistance, running surface grade, footwear, and personal biomechanical efficiency alter real-world energy expenditure.
running-calories-calculator.question: Does running faster burn more calories per kilometer?
running-calories-calculator.answer: Energy expended per kilometer remains relatively constant across aerobic speeds, but running faster burns more calories per unit of time.

tdee-calculator.title: TDEE Calculator
tdee-calculator.description: Calculate your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) based on activity level and basal metabolism.
tdee-calculator.how: Input age, gender, height, weight, and weekly activity profile to compute your maintenance caloric expenditure.
tdee-calculator.limits: Formulaic estimates provide an initial nutritional baseline that should be calibrated against body weight trends over weeks.
tdee-calculator.question: How does NEAT affect TDEE?
tdee-calculator.answer: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis (walking, fidgeting, standing) can vary daily energy burn by hundreds of calories.

waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.title: Waist-to-Height Ratio Calculator
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.description: Assess cardiovascular and cardiometabolic health risks using the waist-to-height ratio.
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.how: Measure waist circumference at the midpoint between the lower rib and iliac crest, then divide by total height.
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.limits: WHtR is an anthropometric risk marker and does not evaluate lipid fractions or blood pressure directly.
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.question: Why is waist-to-height ratio considered superior to BMI?
waist-to-height-ratio-calculator.answer: It directly reflects central visceral abdominal adiposity without confounding muscular mass with fat mass.

waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.title: Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.description: Assess body fat distribution and cardiovascular risk using the waist-to-hip ratio.
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.how: Measure waist circumference at the narrowest point and hip circumference at the widest point of the buttocks.
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.limits: Waist-to-hip ratio reflects anatomical distribution rather than absolute total adipose tissue mass.
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.question: What health risks are linked to a high waist-to-hip ratio?
waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.answer: An android ratio exceeding 0.90 in men or 0.85 in women correlates with higher risk of hypertension and type 2 diabetes.

walking-calories-calculator.title: Walking Calories Calculator
walking-calories-calculator.description: Calculate calories burned while walking based on pace, distance, and body weight.
walking-calories-calculator.how: Select your walking speed, provide distance in kilometers, and input your body weight to determine energetic burn.
walking-calories-calculator.limits: Incline grade, pack weight, ambient temperature, and footwear mechanical cushioning alter final caloric cost.
walking-calories-calculator.question: How does brisk walking compare to running for fat loss?
walking-calories-calculator.answer: Walking burns fewer calories per minute than running, but places minimal stress on connective joint structures.

aquarium-volume-calculator.title: Aquarium Volume Calculator
aquarium-volume-calculator.description: Calculate rectangular or cylindrical aquarium capacity and estimated actual water volume in litres, US gallons, UK gallons, and cubic feet.
aquarium-volume-calculator.how: Select the tank shape (rectangular or cylindrical), enter dimensions, and specify the water fill level and substrate displacement percentage to calculate net water volume.
aquarium-volume-calculator.limits: Water volume estimates assume standard tank geometry and do not account for curved bowfront glass or external sump volumes.
aquarium-volume-calculator.question: How do substrate and decorations affect aquarium water volume?
aquarium-volume-calculator.answer: Gravel, rocks, and driftwood displace water, reducing the actual water capacity of your aquarium typically by 10% to 20% compared to empty volume.

barbell-plate-calculator.title: Barbell Plate Calculator
barbell-plate-calculator.description: Enter your target barbell weight and instantly calculate which plates to load on each side of the bar.
barbell-plate-calculator.how: Set your measurement unit (kg or lb), bar weight, and target weight to get an exact visual breakdown of plates to load per side.
barbell-plate-calculator.limits: Plate combinations use standard commercial denominations and assume equal plate distribution on both sides of the barbell.
barbell-plate-calculator.question: Why does the plate calculator divide the remaining weight by two?
barbell-plate-calculator.answer: A barbell requires identical weight on both the left and right sleeves to preserve balance, safety, and symmetrical lifting mechanics.

battery-charge-time-calculator.title: Battery Charge Time Calculator
battery-charge-time-calculator.description: Estimate how long it takes to charge a battery based on capacity, charger current, charge levels, and charging efficiency.
battery-charge-time-calculator.how: Input the battery capacity in amp-hours (Ah), charger output in amps (A), starting and target percentage, and estimated charging efficiency.
battery-charge-time-calculator.limits: Assumes a simplified constant-current phase; multi-stage charging algorithms like CC/CV will taper current in the top 10–20% of capacity.
battery-charge-time-calculator.question: Why does charging slow down near 100% capacity?
battery-charge-time-calculator.answer: Lithium and lead-acid chargers switch from constant current to constant voltage, reducing current to protect battery chemistry from overheating and voltage spikes.

dimensional-weight-calculator.title: Dimensional Weight Calculator
dimensional-weight-calculator.description: Calculate dimensional or volumetric shipping weight from package dimensions and compare it with actual weight to determine billable weight.
dimensional-weight-calculator.how: Select metric or imperial units, enter box length, width, height, and actual scale weight, along with your carrier’s DIM divisor.
dimensional-weight-calculator.limits: Different carriers use varying dimensional divisors (e.g. 5000 for metric international courier, 139 or 166 for domestic freight).
dimensional-weight-calculator.question: What is dimensional weight and why do carriers charge by it?
dimensional-weight-calculator.answer: Dimensional weight reflects parcel density. Bulky lightweight packages take up significant cargo space, so carriers bill whichever is greater: actual weight or volumetric weight.

electricity-cost-calculator.title: Electricity Cost Calculator – kWh & Appliance Cost
electricity-cost-calculator.description: Calculate appliance electricity use in kWh and estimate running costs from power wattage, daily usage time, billing days, and electricity rate.
electricity-cost-calculator.how: Enter the appliance wattage, average operating hours per day, billing period in days, and local utility rate per kilowatt-hour (kWh).
electricity-cost-calculator.limits: Assumes steady-state electricity consumption; cycling appliances such as refrigerators, air conditioners, and water heaters draw varying power throughout the day.
electricity-cost-calculator.question: How do I find the wattage of an electrical appliance?
electricity-cost-calculator.answer: Check the manufacturer label, nameplate, or power supply sticker on the device, which typically lists power in watts (W) or voltage and current (V × A = W).

fuel-cost-split-calculator.title: Fuel Cost & Passenger Split Calculator
fuel-cost-split-calculator.description: Calculate total trip fuel consumption, include road tolls and parking expenses, and divide the total trip cost evenly per passenger.
fuel-cost-split-calculator.how: Enter your route distance, vehicle fuel efficiency, fuel price, passenger count, and optional toll and parking costs.
fuel-cost-split-calculator.limits: Fuel consumption estimates assume consistent driving conditions and do not reflect elevation changes, heavy traffic, or aggressive driving.
fuel-cost-split-calculator.question: How do I calculate fuel split if some passengers travel only part of the route?
fuel-cost-split-calculator.answer: Compute each segment separately based on that leg’s distance and the passengers present, or split total costs proportionally by individual mileage.

schengen-90-180-day-calculator.title: Schengen 90/180 Day Calculator
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.description: Track short-stay visa-free travel days in the Schengen Area according to the official 90 days within any 180-day rolling rule.
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.how: Enter your evaluation reference date and add past or planned trips with entry and exit dates to check compliance and remaining days.
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.limits: This calculator evaluates the standard Schengen 90/180-day rule for non-EU/EEA passport holders and does not track national long-stay visas or residence permits.
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.question: How is the rolling 180-day Schengen window calculated?
schengen-90-180-day-calculator.answer: On any single calendar day, look back exactly 180 days; the total number of days spent inside the Schengen Area during that window must never exceed 90.

tire-size-calculator.title: Tire Size Calculator
tire-size-calculator.description: Compare original and replacement tire sizes including diameter, sidewall height, circumference, revolutions per mile/km, and speedometer error.
tire-size-calculator.how: Enter the width, aspect ratio, and rim diameter for both your existing and new tires, along with a reference driving speed.
tire-size-calculator.limits: Tire dimensions are calculated according to industry standard nominal sizing; actual mounted tread width and diameter vary slightly by manufacturer and wheel rim width.
tire-size-calculator.question: How much tire size difference is safe for a speedometer?
tire-size-calculator.answer: Most automotive technicians recommend keeping the total tire diameter difference within ±3% of the factory tire to avoid significant speedometer distortion and ABS/traction control errors.

unit-price-calculator.title: Unit Price Calculator
unit-price-calculator.description: Compare two products or package sizes by price per unit and instantly find the best value option and your percentage savings.
unit-price-calculator.how: Enter the total price and quantity/volume for Option A and Option B using the same unit of measure (e.g. grams, kilograms, liters, or pieces).
unit-price-calculator.limits: Unit pricing evaluates direct cost per volume or weight; it does not factor in bulk storage limitations, product expiration dates, or minimum spend thresholds.
unit-price-calculator.question: How do I compare items sold in different units like grams and kilograms?
unit-price-calculator.answer: Convert both items into the same common unit before calculating; for example, convert 500 grams into 0.5 kilograms so both unit prices are measured per kilogram.

website-worth-calculator.title: Website Worth Calculator
website-worth-calculator.description: Estimate website market valuation from traffic, monthly revenue, and profit metrics using standard earnings multiples.
website-worth-calculator.how: Enter the website URL to scan public technical signals, then enter monthly visitor volume, gross revenue, and net profit to compute a market value range.
website-worth-calculator.limits: Provides indicative valuation multiples based on normalized earnings; actual transactions depend on niche, churn, customer acquisition channels, and verified financials.
website-worth-calculator.question: What multiple of profit is typically used to value an online business?
website-worth-calculator.answer: Content, e-commerce, and SaaS websites typically sell for 24× to 40× monthly net profit (or 2.0× to 3.5× annual profit), adjusted for growth, defensibility, and risk.

asphalt-calculator.title: Asphalt Calculator
asphalt-calculator.description: Estimate rectangular asphalt volume, mass, metric tonnes and truckloads from area dimensions, thickness, density and waste allowance.
asphalt-calculator.how: Select metric or imperial units, enter the driveway or lot dimensions, specify compacted asphalt thickness and density, and include a waste allowance.
asphalt-calculator.limits: Planning estimate only. Subbase settling, asphalt mix compaction factor, ambient temperature and delivery conditions affect actual job quantities.
asphalt-calculator.question: How do you calculate asphalt tonnage?
asphalt-calculator.answer: Multiply surface area by compacted thickness to obtain volume, multiply by bulk compacted density (typically 2,240 kg/m³ or 140 lb/cu ft), and add a 5% to 10% allowance for compaction and waste.

board-foot-calculator.title: Board Foot Calculator
board-foot-calculator.description: Calculate nominal lumber board feet (FBM) and total timber cost from lumber dimensions, piece count and board-foot price.
board-foot-calculator.how: Choose imperial or metric dimensions, input the thickness, width and length of the timber, specify the total piece count and price per board foot.
board-foot-calculator.limits: Calculates nominal lumber volume (1 FBM = 144 cubic inches). Surfaced dimensional lumber (S4S) has smaller actual dressed dimensions than rough-sawn lumber.
board-foot-calculator.question: What is a board foot in woodworking?
board-foot-calculator.answer: One board foot is a unit of volume equal to a nominal board one inch thick, twelve inches wide and one foot long, corresponding to 144 cubic inches or approximately 0.00236 cubic meters.

brick-calculator.title: Brick Calculator
brick-calculator.description: Calculate the total bricks and mortar required for a single or multi-wythe wall from dimensions, brick size and mortar joint thickness.
brick-calculator.how: Enter wall dimensions, choose a standard or modular brick size, define the mortar joint width, and add a waste percentage for cuts and breakage.
brick-calculator.limits: Assumes uniform rectangular masonry. Openings for doors and windows, specialized bonding patterns and reinforcement must be evaluated separately.
brick-calculator.question: How many standard bricks are in a square meter of wall?
brick-calculator.answer: For standard bricks (230 × 110 × 70 mm) with a 10 mm mortar joint, a single-skin wall uses approximately 50 to 52 bricks per square meter before waste.

concrete-calculator.title: Concrete Calculator
concrete-calculator.description: Estimate wet concrete volume, cement, sand, gravel aggregate and water requirements for slabs, footings and foundation projects.
concrete-calculator.how: Input the length, width and depth of the slab, choose your measurement unit, and apply a 5% to 10% waste allowance for spillage and subgrade variation.
concrete-calculator.limits: Applies a standard volumetric 1:1.5:3 planning mix. Structural, freeze-thaw or commercial projects must use engineered ready-mix concrete with laboratory mix designs.
concrete-calculator.question: How much concrete do I need for a 10 × 10 slab at 4 inches?
concrete-calculator.answer: A 10 ft by 10 ft slab that is 4 inches thick requires approximately 1.23 cubic yards (or 0.94 cubic meters) of concrete, typically ordered as 1.35 cubic yards with 10% waste.

dumpster-weight-calculator.title: Dumpster Weight Calculator
dumpster-weight-calculator.description: Estimate construction debris tonnage, check dumpster rental weight allowances and calculate potential excess weight overage fees.
dumpster-weight-calculator.how: Select your debris material, enter the volume or area, specify moisture condition, and enter the rental weight limit and per-ton overage rate.
dumpster-weight-calculator.limits: Material densities are loose planning averages. Water content, compaction, mixed materials and demolition methods will change certified scale ticket weights.
dumpster-weight-calculator.question: Can a roll-off dumpster be overweight without being full?
dumpster-weight-calculator.answer: Yes. Dense heavy debris like concrete, brick, dirt and roofing shingles can easily exceed rental weight allowances while filling only a fraction of the container volume.

flooring-calculator.title: Flooring Calculator
flooring-calculator.description: Calculate net and gross floor area, material box quantities and total installed cost including flooring materials and installation labor.
flooring-calculator.how: Enter room dimensions, set square footage prices for materials and labor, and apply a waste factor (typically 10% for straight plank, 15% for diagonal/herringbone).
flooring-calculator.limits: Does not account for complex multi-room transitions, subfloor leveling compounds, underlayment rolls or specialized threshold transitions.
flooring-calculator.question: How much extra flooring should I order for waste?
flooring-calculator.answer: Standard installations require 5% to 10% extra for cuts and defects. Patterned layouts such as herringbone, parquet or angled rooms require 15% to 20% waste allowance.

gravel-calculator.title: Gravel Calculator
gravel-calculator.description: Calculate gravel volume, bulk material weight in metric tonnes and required dump truck loads for driveways, drainage trenches and pathways.
gravel-calculator.how: Enter project length, width and depth, pick your aggregate type (pea gravel, crushed stone, or river rock), and add a settling allowance.
gravel-calculator.limits: Calculations depend on loose bulk density. Compaction under rollers and varying quarry moisture will alter the required weight on site.
gravel-calculator.question: How many tons of gravel are in a cubic yard?
gravel-calculator.answer: A cubic yard of typical crushed gravel or stone weighs approximately 1.35 to 1.5 tons (2,700 to 3,000 pounds), depending on rock composition and compaction.

rebar-calculator.title: Rebar Calculator
rebar-calculator.description: Calculate reinforcement bar count, total linear meters and theoretical steel weight for rectangular concrete slab grids.
rebar-calculator.how: Specify the slab dimensions, rebar diameter, maximum spacing, clear concrete cover and whether the grid is placed in one or both directions.
rebar-calculator.limits: Calculates straight bar material takeoff only. Does not replace structural engineering calculations for lap splices, hooks, corner dowels or chair supports.
rebar-calculator.question: How do you calculate rebar grid weight?
rebar-calculator.answer: Calculate total linear meters of rebar based on clear slab dimensions and grid spacing, then multiply by the theoretical steel mass per meter (d² / 162 in kg/m).

roof-area-calculator.title: Roof Area Calculator
roof-area-calculator.description: Calculate true pitched roof surface area, slope multiplier and roofing squares needed from footprint dimensions, pitch and overhang.
roof-area-calculator.how: Enter building dimensions, roof pitch rise per 12 inches of run, eave and gable overhangs, and a waste allowance for valleys and hip cuts.
roof-area-calculator.limits: Accurate for simple uniform-pitch gable and hip roofs. Multi-pitch roofs, dormers, valleys and architectural features require individual plane measurements.
roof-area-calculator.question: How do you convert flat roof footprint area to pitched roof area?
roof-area-calculator.answer: Multiply the horizontal footprint area (including overhangs) by the rafter pitch factor √(1 + (rise/run)²). For a 6:12 pitch, the multiplier is approximately 1.118.

saw-kerf-calculator.title: Saw Kerf Calculator
saw-kerf-calculator.description: Calculate how many pieces can be cut from raw lumber or sheet stock after accounting for saw blade kerf thickness and cutting waste.
saw-kerf-calculator.how: Enter stock width, desired piece finished width and saw blade kerf thickness to determine piece yield, total blade loss and scrap offcut.
saw-kerf-calculator.limits: Assumes uniform parallel through-cuts without initial rough edge jointing or defect trimming. Curved cuts and grain selection require extra stock.
saw-kerf-calculator.question: What is saw kerf and why does it matter?
saw-kerf-calculator.answer: Kerf is the thickness of wood removed by the saw blade teeth during each cut. Neglecting kerf causes cumulative dimensional errors and reduces piece yield.

air-compressor-cfm-calculator.title: Air Compressor CFM & Tank Runtime Calculator
air-compressor-cfm-calculator.description: Check whether an air compressor can keep up with your air tools using airflow, duty cycle, and tank size.
air-compressor-cfm-calculator.how: Enter your tool rated CFM demand and operating PSI along with duty cycle, then compare against compressor SCFM rating and tank capacity.
air-compressor-cfm-calculator.limits: Estimates nominal airflow balance. Line friction, rapid pulsing tools, ambient temperature, elevation, and regulator loss affect actual sustained pressure.
air-compressor-cfm-calculator.question: How much CFM does an air compressor need for air tools?
air-compressor-cfm-calculator.answer: The compressor must supply at least the average tool consumption (rated CFM multiplied by duty cycle fraction), ideally with a 20% to 30% safety margin for reliable cycling.

construction-cost-calculator.title: Construction Cost Calculator
construction-cost-calculator.description: Estimate building cost from project size and your own cost per square foot, with overhead and contingency options.
construction-cost-calculator.how: Enter the planned floor area in square feet or meters, base cost rate per unit, labor and material percentages, plus overhead and contingency percentages.
construction-cost-calculator.limits: Rough conceptual budgeting model. Material grade specifications, regional labor rates, permitting fees, site topography, and structural complexity alter final bids.
construction-cost-calculator.question: What is a good contingency percentage for construction?
construction-cost-calculator.answer: A 10% to 15% contingency reserve is standard for new residential builds, while remodeling and historic renovations frequently require 15% to 20% for unforeseen conditions.

egress-window-code-checker.title: Egress Window Code Checker
egress-window-code-checker.description: Check net clear window opening width, height, area and sill height against commonly referenced IRC emergency escape and rescue opening dimensions.
egress-window-code-checker.how: Measure and input net clear opening width, clear height, and sill height above finished floor, selecting grade-floor opening if located at ground level.
egress-window-code-checker.limits: Checks baseline IRC prescriptive opening minimums. Local building codes, historic district rules, window well sizes, and operational latch styles must also be satisfied.
egress-window-code-checker.question: What is the minimum size for an egress window?
egress-window-code-checker.answer: Standard IRC requirements specify a minimum net clear opening of 5.7 sq ft (5.0 sq ft at grade floor), minimum clear width of 20 inches, minimum clear height of 24 inches, and maximum 44 inches sill height.

excavation-calculator.title: Excavation Calculator
excavation-calculator.description: Calculate soil excavation volume, loose expanded volume, total weight, and haul truck loads for foundations and trenches.
excavation-calculator.how: Specify trench or pit length, width, and depth in meters or feet, along with soil swell allowance, loose material density, and truck haul payload.
excavation-calculator.limits: Geometric bank excavation estimate. Sloped trench walls, shoring requirements, over-dig for formwork, and moisture changes in soil density vary actual disposal volume.
excavation-calculator.question: Why does soil volume expand during excavation?
excavation-calculator.answer: In-situ undisturbed soil is compacted under natural pressure; digging loosens soil particles and introduces air voids, causing a swell of 15% to 30% depending on soil composition.

ladder-safe-reach-calculator.title: Ladder Safe Reach & 4:1 Calculator
ladder-safe-reach-calculator.description: Estimate extension ladder base distance, setup angle, vertical height and approximate working reach using OSHA 4:1 geometry.
ladder-safe-reach-calculator.how: Input ladder length, user height, and ladder style (extension leaning vs step ladder) to calculate safe standoff distance and approximate working reach.
ladder-safe-reach-calculator.limits: Theoretical geometric reach aid. Safe standing level is limited to manufacturer rung restrictions, never stand on top rungs, and maintain three points of contact.
ladder-safe-reach-calculator.question: What is the OSHA 4:1 ladder safety rule?
ladder-safe-reach-calculator.answer: For every 4 feet of vertical ladder working height, the base of the ladder should be positioned 1 foot away from the supporting structure, yielding a stable ~75.5 degree pitch.

land-area-converter.title: Land Area Converter
land-area-converter.description: Convert land measurements between square feet, square meters, acres, hectares, and square yards.
land-area-converter.how: Input the land area value, choose the source measurement unit, and select the target unit to see precise converted area and full equivalent values.
land-area-converter.limits: Pure mathematical boundary area conversions. Surveying tolerances, earth curvature over vast tracts, and legal boundary descriptions require licensed surveyor verification.
land-area-converter.question: How many square feet are in an acre of land?
land-area-converter.answer: One statute acre contains exactly 43,560 square feet, which equals approximately 4,046.86 square meters or 0.4047 hectares.

osha-portable-toilet-calculator.title: OSHA Portable Toilet Calculator
osha-portable-toilet-calculator.description: Calculate construction-jobsite toilet fixture minimums from workforce size using OSHA 29 CFR 1926.51(c)(1), Table D-1.
osha-portable-toilet-calculator.how: Enter the maximum number of workers on the jobsite during any single shift to determine compliant toilet facilities, seats, and urinals.
osha-portable-toilet-calculator.limits: Applies OSHA construction jobsite standards (Table D-1). Servicing frequency, multi-floor high-rise access, and local public health ordinances may mandate additional units.
osha-portable-toilet-calculator.question: How many portable toilets are required on an OSHA jobsite?
osha-portable-toilet-calculator.answer: OSHA mandates at least 1 facility for 20 or fewer workers, 1 toilet seat and 1 urinal per 40 workers for crews of 21 to 199, and 1 seat and 1 urinal per 50 workers for 200 or more.

solar-panel-calculator.title: Solar Panel Calculator
solar-panel-calculator.description: Calculate solar panel requirements, total array rating, and estimated annual clean energy production for your home or business.
solar-panel-calculator.how: Enter average daily electricity consumption in kilowatt-hours, peak daily sun hours, individual solar panel rating in watts, and expected system losses.
solar-panel-calculator.limits: Preliminary photovoltaic sizing. Shading patterns, roof azimuth pitch, inverter clipping, seasonal sunlight variance, and local utility interconnect caps alter real output.
solar-panel-calculator.question: How many solar panels do I need for my house?
solar-panel-calculator.answer: Divide your daily energy consumption by peak sun hours and derating efficiency to get required kW capacity, then divide by individual panel wattage to determine total panels.

voltage-drop-calculator.title: Voltage Drop Calculator
voltage-drop-calculator.description: Calculate circuit voltage drop, percentage loss, and conductor sizing compliance according to electrical standards.
voltage-drop-calculator.how: Select system voltage, enter continuous current in amps, one-way circuit length, conductor wire gauge, and phase type.
voltage-drop-calculator.limits: Assumes standard copper conductor resistance at 75°C. Complex reactive impedance, extreme temperature derating, harmonic distortion, and conduit fill require licensed engineer verification.
voltage-drop-calculator.question: What is the maximum acceptable voltage drop in a branch circuit?
voltage-drop-calculator.answer: The National Electrical Code (NEC) recommends a maximum voltage drop of 3% for branch circuits and 5% total across feeder and branch circuits combined for optimal efficiency.

wallpaper-calculator.title: Wallpaper Calculator
wallpaper-calculator.description: Calculate total wallpaper rolls, square footage coverage, and pattern waste allowance for single rooms or full walls.
wallpaper-calculator.how: Enter room length, room width, wall ceiling height, roll width, roll length, total window/door deduction area, and waste percentage.
wallpaper-calculator.limits: Pattern repeat matching, intricate murals, architectural arches, and irregular corners may require additional reserve rolls.
wallpaper-calculator.question: How many rolls of wallpaper should I purchase?
wallpaper-calculator.answer: Multiply perimeter by wall height to find gross area, subtract doors and windows, add 10-15% for trimming and repeat matching, then divide by the usable area per roll.

water-tank-calculator.title: Water Tank Calculator
water-tank-calculator.description: Calculate storage capacity and liquid volume in liters, US gallons, and cubic meters for rectangular, cylindrical, or spherical tanks.
water-tank-calculator.how: Choose the tank geometry, select measurement units, and provide the internal dimensions (length, width, height, diameter, or radius).
water-tank-calculator.limits: Calculates internal geometric volume. Actual usable capacity is lower due to overflow weir height, bottom sludge space, and roof truss clearance.
water-tank-calculator.question: How do you calculate tank capacity from dimensions?
water-tank-calculator.answer: For rectangular tanks multiply length by width by height. For cylindrical tanks multiply pi by radius squared by height. Convert cubic meters to liters (1 m³ = 1,000 L) or gallons (1 m³ = 264.172 gal).

wire-size-calculator.title: Wire Size Calculator
wire-size-calculator.description: Recommend minimum AWG conductor gauge based on circuit amperage, voltage, run distance, load factor, and allowable voltage drop.
wire-size-calculator.how: Enter the continuous operating load in amperes, voltage, one-way wire run distance, conductor metal (copper or aluminum), and maximum allowable voltage drop.
wire-size-calculator.limits: Follows baseline NEC ampacity and resistance tables. Extreme ambient temperature derating, conduit bundling factors, and motor inrush currents require licensed electrical engineering review.
wire-size-calculator.question: How do I choose the correct electrical wire size?
wire-size-calculator.answer: Determine design current with a 125% continuous load factor, identify minimum gauge from ampacity charts, and verify whether resistance over long distances requires upsizing to limit voltage drop to 3%.

12-foot-gambrel-roof-truss-calculator.title: 12-Foot Gambrel Roof Truss Calculator
12-foot-gambrel-roof-truss-calculator.description: Calculate gambrel truss lumber, upper and lower rafter lengths, peak height, break point, and roof deck area for 12-foot barn and shed spans.
12-foot-gambrel-roof-truss-calculator.how: Enter building span width, overall building length, eave overhang, truss spacing, and upper/lower pitch angles.
12-foot-gambrel-roof-truss-calculator.limits: Architectural geometry estimate. Snow loads, high wind exposures, gusset plate fastenings, and structural engineering compliance must meet local building codes.
12-foot-gambrel-roof-truss-calculator.question: What makes a gambrel roof truss structurally sound?
12-foot-gambrel-roof-truss-calculator.answer: Gambrel roofs use two distinct rafter pitches per side—a steep lower rafter (typically 60°) for maximum headroom and a shallow upper rafter (typically 30°) for weather shedding—connected with sturdy plywood gussets.

construction-estimate-builder.title: Construction Estimate Builder
construction-estimate-builder.description: Build professional construction project estimates with material, labor, equipment, subcontractor costs, overhead, contingency, and profit margins.
construction-estimate-builder.how: Input direct cost line items (materials, labor, equipment, subcontractors), then set percentage rates for overhead, contingency buffer, contractor markup, and taxes.
construction-estimate-builder.limits: Financial budgeting model. Field productivity variances, supply chain price volatility, scope creep, and change orders must be tracked during project execution.
construction-estimate-builder.question: How do contractors calculate a project estimate?
construction-estimate-builder.answer: Sum all direct costs (materials, labor, plant, subcontractors), apply overhead percentage to cover administrative business expenses, add a contingency reserve, and apply target profit margin before adding sales tax.

contractor-estimate-generator.title: Contractor Estimate Generator
contractor-estimate-generator.description: Generate comprehensive bid quotes and itemized estimates for general contracting and trade subcontracting jobs.
contractor-estimate-generator.how: Enter material procurement, direct labor, machinery rentals, trade subcontractors, then configure overhead, contingency reserves, and target markup percentages.
contractor-estimate-generator.limits: Estimating benchmark. Site conditions, prevailing wage regulations, specialized safety requirements, and client change orders affect final project billing.
contractor-estimate-generator.question: What markup percentage should a general contractor use?
contractor-estimate-generator.answer: Most residential and light commercial contractors apply an overhead rate of 10-15% and a net profit markup of 15-25% depending on project risk and regional competition.

house-construction-cost-calculator.title: House Construction Cost Calculator
house-construction-cost-calculator.description: Estimate total turnkey home building budgets, square footage construction rates, site preparation, soft costs, and land acquisition.
house-construction-cost-calculator.how: Specify building floor area, number of stories, base construction cost per square foot or meter, site development/soft costs, contingency, and land purchase price.
house-construction-cost-calculator.limits: Preliminary feasibility tool. Architectural complexity, premium interior finishes, foundation soil conditions, municipal permit fees, and geographic market variations substantially affect actual turnkey costs.
house-construction-cost-calculator.question: How much does it cost to build a house per square foot?
house-construction-cost-calculator.answer: Turnkey home construction costs typically range from $120 to $250+ per square foot for standard builds, and upwards of $400+ per square foot for custom architectural builds, excluding land.

currency-converter.title: Currency Converter
currency-converter.description: Convert major global currencies using live European Central Bank (ECB) reference rates with automatic offline fallback.
currency-converter.how: Enter the amount, select your source currency, and choose your destination currency. The tool updates rates dynamically.
currency-converter.limits: Reference rates are indicative mid-market figures and do not include commercial bank margins, credit card spreads, or payment gateway fees.
currency-converter.question: How often are ECB foreign exchange reference rates updated?
currency-converter.answer: The European Central Bank updates reference exchange rates once daily on TARGET business days, usually around 16:00 CET.

uk-vat-calculator.title: UK VAT Calculator
uk-vat-calculator.description: Calculate UK Value Added Tax (VAT) for standard (20%), reduced (5%), and zero rates (0%) by adding or extracting tax from prices.
uk-vat-calculator.how: Enter the gross or net price in British Pounds (GBP), select the applicable VAT rate, and choose whether to add or remove VAT.
uk-vat-calculator.limits: Applies strictly to United Kingdom HMRC VAT schedules. Does not verify VAT exemption certificates or special industry schemes.
uk-vat-calculator.question: What is the standard VAT rate in the United Kingdom?
uk-vat-calculator.answer: The standard UK VAT rate set by HMRC is 20%, applied to most commercial goods and services, alongside a 5% reduced rate and 0% zero rate.

sip-calculator.title: SIP Calculator
sip-calculator.description: Calculate mutual fund Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) returns, wealth accumulation corpus, and compound growth.
sip-calculator.how: Enter your monthly investment installment, expected annual return rate, and investment tenure in years.
sip-calculator.limits: Mutual fund investments are subject to market volatility. Assumes a constant annualized return rate without tax or expense deductions.
sip-calculator.question: What is a Systematic Investment Plan (SIP)?
sip-calculator.answer: A SIP is an investment method where an investor deposits a fixed amount regularly into a mutual fund scheme to benefit from rupee cost averaging.

ppf-calculator.title: PPF Calculator
ppf-calculator.description: Calculate Public Provident Fund (PPF) maturity value, total deposit accumulation, and government interest returns.
ppf-calculator.how: Enter your annual contribution amount (up to ₹1.5 lakh), statutory interest rate (currently 7.1%), and investment duration.
ppf-calculator.limits: Subject to sovereign government revisions of quarterly interest rates and statutory annual deposit limits between ₹500 and ₹1,50,000.
ppf-calculator.question: What is the lock-in period for a PPF account?
ppf-calculator.answer: A Public Provident Fund account matures after 15 full financial years, after which it can be extended in 5-year blocks with or without contributions.

fd-calculator.title: Fixed Deposit Calculator
fd-calculator.description: Calculate bank Fixed Deposit (FD) maturity proceeds, accrued interest, and annualized yield across compounding intervals.
fd-calculator.how: Specify the principal deposit amount, annual bank interest rate, investment duration, and compounding frequency.
fd-calculator.limits: Does not factor in Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under Section 194A or premature withdrawal penalty clauses.
fd-calculator.question: How does compounding frequency impact Fixed Deposit returns?
fd-calculator.answer: More frequent compounding (such as quarterly or monthly) produces a marginally higher effective annualized yield than annual compounding.

gst-calculator.title: GST Calculator
gst-calculator.description: Compute Goods and Services Tax (GST) amounts, pre-tax net values, and inclusive or exclusive gross totals with CGST and SGST splits.
gst-calculator.how: Enter the transaction amount, select the applicable GST tax bracket (5%, 12%, 18%, or 28%), and choose inclusive or exclusive mode.
gst-calculator.limits: Calculates intra-state 50:50 CGST/SGST split. For inter-state supplies, the entire tax applies as Integrated GST (IGST).
gst-calculator.question: What is the difference between GST inclusive and exclusive pricing?
gst-calculator.answer: GST inclusive prices already contain the tax amount, whereas GST exclusive prices require adding the tax to the base price.

loan-emi-calculator.title: Loan EMI Calculator
loan-emi-calculator.description: Calculate Equated Monthly Installments (EMI), total interest payments, and total repayment schedules for home, personal, or car loans.
loan-emi-calculator.how: Enter your borrowing principal amount, annual lending interest rate, and loan repayment tenure in years.
loan-emi-calculator.limits: Assumes a fixed interest rate with standard reducing balance amortization. Processing fees, insurance, and prepayment charges are excluded.
loan-emi-calculator.question: How is loan EMI calculated using the reducing balance method?
loan-emi-calculator.answer: EMI is calculated using P × r × (1 + r)^n / ((1 + r)^n - 1), where P is principal, r is periodic interest rate, and n is total monthly installments.

tax-calculator.title: India Income Tax Calculator
tax-calculator.description: Estimate personal income tax liability under India’s New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC) with Section 87A rebate and marginal relief.
tax-calculator.how: Enter your total annual gross taxable income. The calculator applies AY 2026-27 revised tax slabs, rebate, marginal relief, and 4% cess.
tax-calculator.limits: Applies exclusively to individual taxpayers under the New Tax Regime. Does not account for Old Regime deductions like 80C, 80D, or HRA.
tax-calculator.question: What is the tax rebate threshold under the New Tax Regime for AY 2026-27?
tax-calculator.answer: Under the revised New Tax Regime, taxable income up to ₹12 lakh incurs zero net tax due to the enhanced Section 87A rebate and marginal relief.

debt-snowball-vs-avalanche-calculator.title: Debt Snowball vs Avalanche Calculator
debt-snowball-vs-avalanche-calculator.description: Compare month-by-month debt payoff acceleration between highest interest rate (avalanche) and lowest balance (snowball) strategies.
debt-snowball-vs-avalanche-calculator.how: Enter balances, interest rates, minimum payments, and your optional monthly extra payment to compare payoff timeline and interest savings.
debt-snowball-vs-avalanche-calculator.limits: Assumes static interest rates and consistent payments without new charges, penalty rates, or variable credit card APR shifts.
debt-snowball-vs-avalanche-calculator.question: What is the primary difference between debt avalanche and debt snowball?
debt-snowball-vs-avalanche-calculator.answer: The avalanche method pays off highest-interest debt first to save the most total interest, while the snowball method prioritizes smallest balances for fast psychological wins.

retirement-calculator.title: Retirement Corpus & Income Calculator
retirement-calculator.description: Simulate your required retirement corpus, projected savings growth, inflation-adjusted post-retirement income, and sustainability score.
retirement-calculator.how: Enter your current age, target retirement age, monthly expenses, existing retirement corpus, monthly contribution, and assumed investment return.
retirement-calculator.limits: Uses deterministic compounding and inflation models; does not incorporate sequence-of-returns risk or unpredictable healthcare shocks.
retirement-calculator.question: How does inflation impact retirement corpus requirements?
retirement-calculator.answer: Even moderate inflation drastically erodes future purchasing power, requiring a significantly larger retirement corpus to sustain identical lifestyle expenses.

cashflow-budget-architect.title: Cashflow & Budget Architecture Planner
cashflow-budget-architect.description: Organize monthly personal cash flow, audit 50/30/20 budget allocations across needs and wants, and calculate emergency runway reserves.
cashflow-budget-architect.how: Enter your monthly take-home income along with essential needs expenses, discretionary wants spending, and committed savings deposits.
cashflow-budget-architect.limits: Allocations are guideline models; variable utility costs, seasonal expenses, and irregular freelance earnings should be averaged.
cashflow-budget-architect.question: What is the traditional 50/30/20 personal budgeting rule?
cashflow-budget-architect.answer: The 50/30/20 rule recommends dedicating 50% of net income to essential needs, 30% to discretionary wants, and 20% to savings and debt reduction.

investment-return-profiler.title: Investment Return & CAGR Profiler
investment-return-profiler.description: Calculate compound annual growth rate (CAGR), absolute return on investment (ROI), net capital gains, and wealth accumulation multiples.
investment-return-profiler.how: Specify your initial investment capital, ending value, investment duration in years, and optional annual recurring capital additions.
investment-return-profiler.limits: Does not account for capital gains taxation, dividend reinvestment timing, transaction brokerage charges, or currency fluctuations.
investment-return-profiler.question: Why is CAGR preferred over average annual return for multi-year investments?
investment-return-profiler.answer: CAGR accounts for compound interest and geometric volatility, accurately reflecting the constant annual growth rate needed to reach final portfolio value.

loan-amortization-suite.title: Loan Amortization & Accelerated Payoff Suite
loan-amortization-suite.description: Analyze monthly loan amortization schedules, accelerated prepayment impact, interest reductions, and payoff tenure contraction.
loan-amortization-suite.how: Provide your total loan principal, annual interest rate, tenure in years, and planned monthly prepayment amount.
loan-amortization-suite.limits: Calculations apply reducing balance compounding and do not include loan origination fees, mortgage insurance, or prepayment penalties.
loan-amortization-suite.question: How does extra monthly principal prepayment reduce overall loan cost?
loan-amortization-suite.answer: Prepayments directly lower the remaining loan principal, preventing future compound interest accrual and shortening the overall amortization period.

savings-retirement-hub.title: Savings Target & Wealth Accumulation Hub
savings-retirement-hub.description: Calculate the necessary monthly recurring savings required to achieve a targeted financial corpus within your chosen investment timeline.
savings-retirement-hub.how: Enter your target financial goal, planning horizon in years, expected annual return rate, and existing accumulated savings.
savings-retirement-hub.limits: Assumes continuous compounding and stable reinvestment returns without considering market drawdowns or withdrawal tax implications.
savings-retirement-hub.question: How do starting early and compound interest affect monthly savings needs?
savings-retirement-hub.answer: Longer investment horizons allow compound interest to do the heavy lifting, dramatically reducing the monthly contribution required to hit your target corpus.

taxation-compliance-deck.title: Tax Regime Comparison & Compliance Deck
taxation-compliance-deck.description: Evaluate annual personal income tax liabilities under New vs Old tax regimes with eligible deductions under Section 80C, 80D, NPS, and HRA.
taxation-compliance-deck.how: Input your annual gross taxable earnings alongside qualifying deductions to instantly view side-by-side tax liability and regime recommendations.
taxation-compliance-deck.limits: Calculated under standard individual slab structures for salaried taxpayers; does not cover capital gains, business income, or foreign earnings.
taxation-compliance-deck.question: When is the Old Tax Regime more beneficial than the New Tax Regime?
taxation-compliance-deck.answer: The Old Regime is generally more advantageous when total eligible deductions (80C, 80D, NPS, home loan interest, and HRA) exceed regime crossover thresholds.

wealth-inflation-matrix.title: Wealth & Inflation Purchasing Power Matrix
wealth-inflation-matrix.description: Model the real purchasing power of wealth over time by contrasting nominal compound returns against expected long-term inflation rates.
wealth-inflation-matrix.how: Input present wealth capital, anticipated annual inflation rate, expected investment return rate, and forward time horizon in years.
wealth-inflation-matrix.limits: Assumes static annual inflation and returns, whereas historical inflation fluctuates and living cost increases vary across expenditure baskets.
wealth-inflation-matrix.question: What is real return versus nominal return?
wealth-inflation-matrix.answer: Nominal return is the raw percentage gain before expenses, while real return subtracts inflation to reflect actual expansion of purchasing power.

merge-pdf.title: Merge PDF Online
merge-pdf.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one clean document directly in your browser without uploading files to an external server.
merge-pdf.how: Upload two or more PDF files, arrange their order, and click merge to produce a single consolidated document.
merge-pdf.limits: Encrypted or password-protected PDF files must be unlocked before merging.
merge-pdf.question: Are my files uploaded to a remote server when merging?
merge-pdf.answer: No. All PDF merging takes place entirely inside your web browser using local client-side memory.

split-pdf.title: Split PDF Online
split-pdf.description: Separate specific page ranges or extract individual sections from your PDF file instantly and securely in your browser.
split-pdf.how: Select your PDF document, define the comma-separated page ranges or page numbers to separate, and save the extracted document.
split-pdf.limits: Does not modify or re-encode password-protected documents unless permissions are granted.
split-pdf.question: Can I extract non-consecutive pages from a PDF?
split-pdf.answer: Yes. You can specify individual page numbers and ranges such as 1-3, 5, 8-10 to extract distinct segments.

rotate-pdf.title: Rotate PDF Pages Online
rotate-pdf.description: Rotate inverted or landscape PDF pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees to correct document orientation locally.
rotate-pdf.how: Choose your PDF, select the rotation angle, and apply the rotation to generate an upright document ready for viewing or printing.
rotate-pdf.limits: Applies rotation across document pages without altering existing text or embedded vector elements.
rotate-pdf.question: Does rotating PDF pages degrade visual resolution?
rotate-pdf.answer: No. PDF page rotation updates standard viewing transformation matrices without recompressing underlying graphics or rasterizing text.

reorder-pdf.title: Reorder PDF Pages Online
reorder-pdf.description: Rearrange and resequence the page order of your PDF document locally without uploading files to third-party services.
reorder-pdf.how: Upload your document, enter the desired numeric page sequence separated by commas, and rebuild your document.
reorder-pdf.limits: Requires entering valid numeric indices corresponding to existing pages in the uploaded document.
reorder-pdf.question: Can I repeat or duplicate pages when reordering?
reorder-pdf.answer: Yes. Specifying a page number multiple times in the sequence allows you to duplicate pages into the output document.

delete-pdf-pages.title: Delete PDF Pages Online
delete-pdf-pages.description: Remove unwanted, blank, or duplicate pages from your PDF file quickly and privately in your browser.
delete-pdf-pages.how: Select your document, specify the page numbers or ranges to exclude, and download the trimmed PDF.
delete-pdf-pages.limits: You cannot delete all pages; at least one page must remain in the final output document.
delete-pdf-pages.question: Is the page deletion process permanent?
delete-pdf-pages.answer: The original file on your computer remains untouched; a new cleaned PDF file is generated for download.

extract-pdf-pages.title: Extract PDF Pages Online
